header: Canonical governance fixture manifest. Every file under tests/fixtures/ must be accounted for by an entry here or by a fixture_entries.json fragment (infrastructure files themselves are never violations). Entries carry the class of the fixture, its byte digest, and the expected consumers/semantics; research/governance/fixture_manifest.py validates all of it fail-closed.

fixtures.purpose: Synthetic replica of the historical CRYPTO-V17 legacy state shape (v17_run_artifact_v1): stale 40-hex head field plus additive hard_stop_reason, used to exercise stale-head drift warning and PAUSED_MAINTENANCE derivation through the full build_registry_from_legacy read path.
fixtures.license_authority: repo-owner-authored synthetic fixture; hand-computed placeholder values, no third-party material
expected_semantics: byte preservation of legacy source reads (sha256 before == sha256 after a full build_registry_from_legacy read)
stale-head drift surfaces as a recorded-not-normalized adapter warning
hard_stop_reason derives PAUSED_MAINTENANCE in the composed registry

fixtures.purpose: Synthetic replica of the historical FOREX-FREE-V8 open-state shape (forex_free_v8_cycle_state_v1): no status field, prose head, budget object with planned/used/bound_by_selection, hard_stop_reason present; exercises prose-head warning and forex budget-shape normalization.
fixtures.license_authority: repo-owner-authored synthetic fixture; hand-computed placeholder values, no third-party material
expected_semantics: byte preservation of legacy source reads (sha256 before == sha256 after a full build_registry_from_legacy read)
prose head surfaces as a recorded-not-normalized adapter warning (measured branch head used as authority)
forex budget object normalizes to {used, max, bound_by_selection}

fixtures.purpose: Synthetic replica of the measured 2026-09-09 FOREX-FREE-V8 closed shape: no status field, closure recorded in the phase prose; exercises TERMINAL derivation from the phase and the derived-terminal recorded-not-normalized warning through the full composition path.
fixtures.license_authority: repo-owner-authored synthetic fixture; hand-computed placeholder values, no third-party material
expected_semantics: byte preservation of legacy source reads (sha256 before == sha256 after a full build_registry_from_legacy read)
TERMINAL derived from a closure phase with the derivation warning recorded (recorded-not-normalized, never a KeyError)
terminal GO phrase state is DEAD (P-8: no GO survives its cycle's close)
